main.bio: I am a backend engineer focused on building resilient, scalable systems and performant APIs. Experienced in system architecture, database optimization, and handling complex data ingestion pipelines. skills.name: Low-Level File I/O & Data Structures (Event Store)

projects.title: Demographic & Gender Classification API
projects.about: A high-performance API that integrates external microservices to analyze name strings and predict key demographic attributes (gender, age, nationality) under strict response budgets. Features aggressive caching and resilient error fallbacks.

projects.title: Insighta Labs (Demographic Search & Ingestion)
projects.about: A multi-client demographic intelligence engine. Features a custom rule-based query parser converting English queries into dynamic filters, and a memory-efficient chunked CSV streaming processor capable of handling up to 500,000 records without blocking reads.

projects.title: Append-Only Event Store
projects.about: A lightweight, crash-resilient custom key-value store engineered from scratch. Utilizes low-level native Node.js file operations for append-only transaction logs. Employs an in-memory hash index mapping event IDs to precise byte offsets for O(1) direct reads.

projects.title: Flowbrand API (AI Funnel Generator)
projects.about: A collaborative funnel generation platform backend handling user state from session creation to complete marketing funnels. Integrated external AI models for automated layout synthesis.
